objective: Improvement in expected competition score through representation
hypothesis: A causal student that updates on every row but gates state decay/update using elapsed rows since paired i0_p0/i0_p11 price-code changes and target dwell will represent irregular target transitions more efficiently than an otherwise matched row-time GRU.
falsifiers: On the full fixed 468-group stream, paired price-code event timing does not organize target-change or official target-weight mass beyond sequence activity strata.
On a matched own-weight row-clock versus dual-clock student comparison, the event-clock component fails to improve the complete fixed-panel endpoint or causes unstable sequence reset/latency.
discriminating_test: First run the approved six-column one-row-group-at-a-time fixed-468 descriptive scan with target-change co-location and official clipped-label-magnitude contribution by activity/label-clock regime. Only then train matched independently initialized own-weight student pairs with identical cache, optimizer, seeds, updates, and membership; change only the dual-clock mechanism.
exposure: Fold0 validation is previously exposed; scan is descriptive and any grade is development evidence.

objective: Improvement in expected competition score through reducing student prediction variance
direction: single fixed-fold student versus equal two-seed prediction mean
hypothesis: Averaging two independently trained students with the same clean H230 recipe may outperform either member by reducing training variation, separate from the heterogeneous-family target effect.
evidence_basis: reference candidate manifest identifies seed5/6 pair
H230 public handoff identifies one seed3 member
falsifiers: The equal pair mean does not exceed the stronger member on the same fixed panel, or its benefit disappears under delivered i16 inference.
A difference is explained by changed fit membership, cache, source coefficients, or checkpoint selection rather than member averaging.
discriminating_test: Fit fresh own-weight seed3 and seed4 H230 students from seed-matched own initializers using identical fold-0 fit groups, cache, fixed epoch, and settings. Freeze predictions first; evaluate each and the equal mean on the same 468 groups using global_wp_clip2_v1 at FP32 and packaged i16.
exposure: Fold0 validation is previously exposed; no public-transfer claim.

objective: Improvement in expected competition score through more useful distillation updates
direction: two-epoch versus longer fixed schedule, family head on/off matched
hypothesis: More student optimization after the same heterogeneous teacher cache may improve the main served head, while the effect of family auxiliary targets may depend on update budget.
evidence_basis: reference lane: two epochs with fixed final epoch1
H230 matched family-off point delta +0.00006101 with 95% component interval [-0.00009144,+0.00021050]
H230 matched control has same exposed fit/evaluation membership
falsifiers: At a predeclared longer fixed epoch, both family-off and family-on endpoints fail to improve their same-budget counterparts, with no favorable interaction across seeds.
Any apparent gain is driven by selecting the best epoch on evaluation groups or by changing cache/init/membership across cells.
discriminating_test: Use a 2x2 design: family weight 0 or .1 crossed with fixed epoch1 or fixed epoch3 after a four-epoch schedule. Keep own initialization, raw source cache, 0.8125 main-target scale, optimizer, training rows, paired seeds, and evaluator frozen. Compare complete endpoints and seed-pair means; evaluation groups never select checkpoints.
exposure: Fold0 validation is previously exposed; no public-transfer claim.

objective: Improvement in expected competition score through teacher-source coverage
direction: reference-inspired source mixture versus H230 same-fold wide-baseline substitution
hypothesis: Replacing the compact orgbase and single strong-source identities with paired independently trained own sources may help or hurt depending on source complementarity, even when total main-target coefficient mass remains 0.8125.
evidence_basis: H230 source coefficients have the same totals but use paired own combo and GRU384 same-fold sources
H230 source identities and training memberships differ from public final
falsifiers: A frozen source-only factorial shows no relevant interaction with teacher outputs or student endpoint, or any apparent gain follows an unintended target normalization/clipping/cache change.
discriminating_test: On a clean fold-safe membership and fixed own initialization/schedule, change one source family at a time while pinning coefficient sum, target scaling, raw/clipped target mode, family targets, and all other sources. Record target-mass and row-order hashes before fit; grade the full fixed endpoint.
exposure: All currently available validation panels have prior exposure; use for development, then confirm on an appropriately untouched external outcome if available.

objective: Correctness of scored-row weighting and state semantics
hypothesis: No mask or reset mismatch is currently evidenced; a deterministic row-weight and sequence-reset parity probe can falsify this assessment if the two source paths differ in handling warmup, unscored rows, or sequence changes.
evidence_basis: Both reference and H230 commands specify propensity prop_f0, power2, epsilon.03, and valid-true-mask.03
falsifiers: A frozen source input exhibits a different per-row main loss weight or changes recurrent state on different rows, or reset differs at a seq_ix boundary.
discriminating_test: With no fitting, synthesize representative whole sequences and run a one-batch deterministic parity probe that records row weights, warmup handling, state advancement, and reset behavior. Compare source math and H230 math; retain official evaluator mask unchanged.
exposure: Exact determinism test; not a performance experiment.
